ext.note: EXAMPLE BASELINE (docs/POLICY.md). Every external lane is deny and nothing is approved, so this file opens nothing. Copy it, raise revision, and open one lane at a time: set the lane to allow AND add approvals.<lane> with a real ticket or sign-off reference. The Team ID in llm.claude_bin_pin is a placeholder that matches no real signature; replace it before llm is ever allowed. min_pipeline_version is 0.1.0 only so that this example stays valid for every pipeline that can read a policy; the Swift app requires at least 0.2.0 whenever a policy exists, and a real policy should say 0.2.0 or higher once the fleet runs it.
